template_data.headline_html: Four myths that never survive the numbers.

items.title: Only primes win
items.desc: Small businesses pulled $21.9B from DoD alone in Q2 2026. One quarter. Source · USAspending.gov.

items.title: No past performance, no chance
items.desc: Teaming agreements let you subcontract first. Build the record while earning — then prime.

items.title: Schedule takes too long
items.desc: Approved once, valid 20 years. Missing recompetes today means you didn't start 18 months ago.

items.title: Federal pricing kills margins
items.desc: GSA locks in a pre-negotiated rate. Good pricing protects your margin. Bad pricing hands the bid away.
